verdict.rationale: OpenAI publishes a dedicated rate-limits guide that covers limits and how they scale. Related guides confirm tokens-per-minute accounting (cached input tokens still count toward TPM) and a separate, higher rate-limit pool for Batch. missing for 10: evidence of what a 429 response looks like (headers/error body), explicit requests-per-minute and per-tier figures, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read documented rate limits — requests and tokens per unit time, how tiers scale, and what a 429 looks like — before I hit them in production

citations.quote: A dedicated rate-limits guide documents limits and how they scale
Cached input tokens still count toward tokens-per-minute limits
a separate pool of significantly higher rate limits
